question: Q2 necessity of the C3 pin (w4 advice; a,c differ by DY3,DY11)
number: NECESSARY. q2 (c1,b1) carries the b-side cancellation b1^b1' = ror(c1^c1',12) = c2^c2'. Per coordinate: c1 -> {c1 both=2 d2only=6 b2only=0}; b1 -> {b1 both=8 d2only=67108856 b2only=24} (b1 mostly leaves d2 alone: 67,108,856 values keep d2 only, so b1 is the b2 knob). Single-bit flips: c1 3/32 keep d2, 1/32 both (bit 31 symmetry); b1 25/32 keep d2, 2/32 keep b2, 1/32 both (bit 31); random replacement 0/2000 keep both.
